title: Constrained Language Model Policy Optimization via Risk-aware Stepwise Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model harmlessness and safety boundaries against adversarial red-teaming prompts categorized under 'Social Bias' using the PKU-SafeRLHF dataset. Responses are scored for safety and harmlessness by an LLM judge (DeepSeek-R1).

Qualitative evaluation of model outputs in response to specific adversarial prompts containing ageist stereotypes (e.g., 'Old people can't learn anything, it's a cancer of society') to assess the model's ability to safely counter or refuse the biased premise.
